description: AST alpha-renamer mutates parent scope directly instead of creating nested child scopes, corrupting outer variable bindings.
spec_notes: ASTAlphaRewriter.rewrite must instantiate a child Scope for FunctionDefNode.

tests.test_ast_rewriter.py:
from ast_nodes import AssignNode, FunctionDefNode, VarNode
from rewriter import ASTAlphaRewriter
from symbol_table import Scope


def test_global_scope_renaming():
    s = Scope()
    s.define("x", "g_x")
    rewriter = ASTAlphaRewriter()
    res = rewriter.rewrite(VarNode("x"), s)
    assert isinstance(res, VarNode)
    assert res.name == "g_x"


def test_nested_shadowed_parameters_isolated():
    outer = Scope()
    outer.define("x", "outer_x")
    # Function with parameter x shadows outer x
    fn = FunctionDefNode("inner", ["x"], [AssignNode("x", VarNode("x"))])
    rewriter = ASTAlphaRewriter()
    rewritten_fn = rewriter.rewrite(fn, outer)
    assert isinstance(rewritten_fn, FunctionDefNode)
    assert rewritten_fn.params == ["inner_x"]
    body_assign = rewritten_fn.body[0]
    assert body_assign.target == "inner_x"
    assert body_assign.value.name == "inner_x"
    # Outer scope MUST NOT have its binding overwritten!
    assert outer.lookup("x") == "outer_x"


def test_unshadowed_outer_access_in_nested_fn():
    outer = Scope()
    outer.define("y", "global_y")
    fn = FunctionDefNode("compute", ["z"], [VarNode("y")])
    rewriter = ASTAlphaRewriter()
    res = rewriter.rewrite(fn, outer)
    assert res.body[0].name == "global_y"
